claims.citation: New York Herald, 18 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Victory, Briggs, Liverpool April 1, with mdse and 714
passengers, to Daniel Ogden. Was up to lon 32 45 in 7 days
from port; since then had heavy westerly weather most of
the time. One birth and five deaths. 13th inst, lat 42, lon [cut]
64, was in company with ship Corsica, from Liverpool for
New York.
